purpose: Add calm Taglish narration to the Oceanides 16:9 wastewater-treatment meeting explainer after the user reviews the visual draft and exact wording.

input.selection: Each scenes[].vo in order, joined with two LF newlines; headings are not spoken.

limits.costBasis: Multilingual v2 bills one ElevenLabs credit per input character. Credit value depends on the existing account plan; this spec does not authorize cash purchases.

pass: Spoken wording exactly matches approved source; no missing or added sentences.
Taglish is intelligible and calm; inspect STP, septage, microorganisms, sludge and Oceanides pronunciation by listening to the complete take.
No truncation, broken audio, prominent artifacts or sample clipping.
Narration is aligned with the corresponding process scenes; adjust local scene durations to the approved take without changing wording.
Final H.264/AAC MP4 remains 1920x1080, 16:9, 30fps with legible labels and retained scope/maintenance disclosures.
fail: Any provider error, wording omission, unintelligible key term, clipped take or voice artifact.
More than one TTS request, more than 1500 credits, or any changed text, voice, model or settings without fresh approval.
evidence: Input hash and character count checked before the call.
Provider request count and returned media metadata; no credentials in logs.
Full-take listening notes and measured audio levels.
Final MP4 decode, duration and streams; visual samples across every scene and transitions.
delivery: Local review files and a draft PR only. No public publication, deployment or merge.
